title: Separate the variables
text: Dividing both sides by $$\tan{y}$$ gives $$\cot{y}\, dy=-2x\, dx$$ and the left side integrates to $$\ln|\sin{y}|$$

title: Integrate and solve
text: This gives $$\ln|\sin{y}|=-x^2+C$$ and at $$x=0$$, $$sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)=1$$, so $$C=0$$. Then $$sin(y)=e^{\left(-x^2\right)}$$, so $$y=\arcsin\left(e^{\left(-x^2\right)}\right)$$.
